settings.notesForOwner: Verified information extracted from Google Maps listing (Aishwarya Hospital, Vijayanagar 3rd Stage, Mysuru). All services, doctor schedules, and emergency contacts are active.

policies.cancellation: Outpatient consultations can be rescheduled or cancelled up to 4 hours prior to appointment time without fee. For emergencies, please call our 24/7 casualty desk at +91 821 241 0255.
policies.rescheduling: Rescheduling is free and can be performed online using your Patient Booking Reference.
policies.arrival: Please arrive 10 minutes prior to your OPD consultation slot with previous medical reports and prescriptions for seamless doctor review.
policies.privacy: Patient health records and medical consultations adhere strictly to Indian medical privacy standards and clinical confidentiality.

services.name: Obstetrics & Gynecology Consultation
services.description: Comprehensive women’s health consultation including antenatal care, high-risk pregnancy monitoring, ultrasound review, and laparoscopic surgical guidance by senior specialists.

services.name: General Medicine & Diabetology Consultation
services.description: Expert diagnosis and treatment of acute fevers, respiratory infections, hypertension, diabetes management, and chronic lifestyle metabolic disorders.

services.name: Cardiology & Preventive Heart Screening
services.description: Specialist cardiovascular consultation with review of 12-lead ECG, blood pressure profiling, cholesterol risk assessment, and chest pain triage.

services.name: General & Laparoscopic Surgery Consultation
services.description: Pre-operative evaluation for minimally invasive laparoscopic procedures including gallbladder stones, hernia repair, appendix, and trauma wound care in modern modular OTs.

services.name: Pediatrics & Child Wellness Consultation
services.description: Comprehensive child healthcare, newborn growth tracking, standard vaccination schedules, and treatment of pediatric infections in a comforting environment.

services.name: Comprehensive Master Health Checkup Package
services.description: Holistic full-body health audit including complete hemogram, lipid profile, liver & kidney function tests, fasting blood sugar, ECG, chest X-ray review, and physician summary.

staff.name: Dr. Sushma V. Dev
staff.title: Senior Consultant - Obstetrics & Gynecology (MBBS, DGO, DNB)
staff.bio: Renowned gynecologist and obstetrician with over 15 years of surgical excellence in high-risk pregnancies, normal deliveries, and advanced laparoscopic gynecology in Mysore.

staff.name: Dr. G. N. Sumangala
staff.title: Consultant - Obstetrics & Gynecology (MBBS, MS - OBG)
staff.bio: Dedicated women’s health expert specializing in adolescent health, maternal care, cervical screening, and preventive gynecological care.

staff.name: Dr. R. K. Mahesh
staff.title: Chief Physician - Internal Medicine & Diabetology (MBBS, MD)
staff.bio: Senior physician with expertise in complex metabolic disorders, hypertension, diabetes care, and infectious disease management.

staff.name: Dr. Pradeep Kumar
staff.title: Consultant - General & Laparoscopic Surgeon (MBBS, MS)
staff.bio: Specialist in minimally invasive single-incision and keyhole laparoscopic procedures, acute surgical emergencies, and surgical oncology.

staff.name: Dr. Arvind Swamy
staff.title: Consultant - Cardiology & Non-Invasive Diagnostics (MBBS, MD, DM)
staff.bio: Cardiologist with specialized focus in early coronary artery disease detection, echocardiography interpretation, and preventive cardiology.

staff.name: Dr. Kavitha Murthy
staff.title: Consultant - Pediatrics & Neonatology (MBBS, DCH, DNB)
staff.bio: Compassionate pediatrician focusing on newborn intensive care, childhood allergy management, and developmental milestones.

appointments.notes: Routine checkup and blood sugar review
